turns.speaker: SPEAKER A (Woman)
turns.text: Excuse me, could you tell me what time the next train to Central Station leaves?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER B (Man)
turns.text: Sure, let me check... The next one leaves at 3:45, but it's usually a few minutes late.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER A (Woman)
turns.text: Oh no, I have a meeting at 4:15. Is there a faster way to get there?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER B (Man)
turns.text: You could take the express bus outside the station. It only takes fifteen minutes, but it leaves in five minutes, so you'd better hurry.

turns.speaker: Airport Announcer
turns.text: Attention passengers. Flight 205 to London, originally scheduled to depart at 6:30 p.m., has been delayed due to bad weather conditions. The new departure time is 8:15 p.m. Passengers are kindly requested to remain in the boarding area and listen for further announcements. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER A (Manager)
turns.text: Morning, Claire. I wanted to talk to you about the client presentation next week.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER B (Claire)
turns.text: Of course. I've already prepared most of the slides, but I'm still waiting on the sales figures from the finance team.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER A (Manager)
turns.text: That's fine, they should send them by Wednesday. Do you think you'll need extra time to rehearse?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER B (Claire)
turns.text: Actually, yes. I was hoping we could do a practice run on Thursday afternoon, if that works for you.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER A (Manager)
turns.text: Thursday afternoon works well for me. Let's book the conference room for two o'clock.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER B (Claire)
turns.text: Perfect, I'll send a calendar invite.
